personal_token.label: Robot token
personal_token.where: sanity.io/manage > your project > API > Tokens > Add API token, with Viewer permission.
notes: Use a robot token with Viewer, not a personal token: it is scoped to one project and does not carry a human's permissions across every project they belong to.
A public dataset needs no token at all. A token is only required for a private dataset or for mutations, and this connector is read-only.
The API host is per project - {projectId}.api.sanity.io - so the base URL cannot be fixed and has to be built from the project id.
The date in the path is the API version and pins response shape. Left unpinned, Sanity uses the newest and the shape can change under you.

query.notes: GROQ via the query parameter. Long queries must be POSTed instead - URLs have a length limit and GROQ gets long.

rate_limits.note: Query volume is billed rather than hard-limited on most plans; an unbounded loop costs money rather than returning 429.
